title: Hart board service before 1995: Aliano, Hassel, Olivares, Hanrion and the 1985-1995 board
by: Claude Code research agent, read only (no database writes, no git)
body: William S. Hart Union High School District #21588

people.name: George Aliano

terms.start: 1994-05 (chosen by the board the weekend of 14-15 May 1994; swearing-in scheduled for Wednesday, 18 May 1994)
terms.end: 1995-12 (then elected to the short term; held as #28604)
terms.seat: at large; the seat Peter Warren vacated (Warren elected 1993)
terms.confidence: high for the appointment and its month; medium for 18 May 1994 as the day he took the seat (the article gives a scheduled date, not a report that it happened)

evidence.source: Douglas Alger, "Aliano to Join Hart School Board," Los Angeles Times, May 17, 1994, https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1994-05-17-me-58785-story.html
evidence.quote: George Aliano was chosen from eight applicants interviewed this weekend by the four other board members to fill the William S. Hart Union High School District trustee post that Peter Warren vacated in March. ... Aliano is scheduled to be sworn in Wednesday. ... Trustees opted to fill the seat by appointment rather than pay for a special election.

evidence.source: Leon Worden, William S. Hart Union High School District Governing Board Members, 1945 to Date, SCVHistory.com, /scvhistory/hartschoolboardmembers.htm
evidence.quote: George Aliano (appointed to complete Warren's unexpired term)

evidence.source: Mark Sabbatini, "Board to Weigh Plan for Student Uniforms," Los Angeles Times, May 11, 1994, https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1994-05-11-me-56418-story.html
evidence.quote: All four board members said they support uniforms to some degree

evidence.source: Mark Sabbatini, "District to Receive Plan for Uniforms at New Santa Clarita School," Los Angeles Times, May 18, 1994, https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1994-05-18-me-59152-story.html
evidence.quote: The proposal appears to have firm support from at least three of the four trustees

evidence.source: California Elections Data Archive (CEDA), CEDA1995Data.xls, rows 1422-1427, a compilation of the County's returns (inventory/elections/ceda-scv.json)
evidence.quote: term "Short", George Aliano, 4,659 votes of 7,906, elected, incumbent, designation "Police Captain"

terms.note: The LA Times is independent of the roster. CEDA 1995 confirms the short-term (remainder of a vacant term) contest that follows an appointment. Archive #28602 has termStartEdtf 1994 (year only); this dates it to May 1994.

evidence.source: California Elections Data Archive (CEDA), CEDA1995Data.xls, rows 1422-1427, a compilation of the County's returns (inventory/elections/ceda-scv.json)
evidence.quote: see above

terms.note: End of service: roster "George Aliano, Clerk (did not seek reelection in 1997)"; CEDA 1997 and the LA Times of Nov 2 and Nov 6, 1997 list four candidates and no Aliano. The LA Times of Nov 4 and Nov 5, 1997 (Dade Hayes) wrongly name him an incumbent candidate and a defeated incumbent. #28604 howEnded expired is consistent with the roster and CEDA.

leads: LA Times, June 1, 1996 ("Figures Show Valley Crime Rate Continuing to Decline") quotes "Capt. George Aliano" of the LAPD Foothill Division. The 1994 article calls the trustee a Los Angeles police officer and CEDA 1995 gives "Police Captain", so this is probably the same man, but no source joins them: a lead, not stated.
A George Aliano in LA Times prep sports, 1985-86 (Saugus High), is a student of the time and not the trustee.

people.name: John Hassel
people.result: partly found (start year independently confirmed; the 1991 election return not found)

terms.confidence: high for 1991 to 1995 service; the 1991 vote count and placing not found

evidence.source: Leon Worden, William S. Hart Union High School District Governing Board Members, 1945 to Date, SCVHistory.com, /scvhistory/hartschoolboardmembers.htm
evidence.quote: John R. Hassel (elected 1991)

evidence.source: Santa Clarita Valley Facilities Foundation, Creating Value: Story of a Public-Private Partnership (Point of View Communications, August 20, 2014), "The Passing of a School Board Legend," p. 18, SCVHistory.com, /scvhistory/scvff082014.htm (PDF /scvhistory/files/scvff082014/scvff082014.pdf)
evidence.quote: John Hassel served two terms on the William S. Hart Union High School District Governing Board from 1991 - 1999.

evidence.source: Douglas Alger, "Schools' Plan Would Let Bible Study Groups Meet in Classrooms," Los Angeles Times, June 18, 1993, https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1993-06-18-me-4579-story.html
evidence.quote: "Once the box is open, hold on. It could be a rough ride," said trustee John Hassel.

evidence.source: Mark Sabbatini, "District Considers Campus Cutbacks, Layoffs," Los Angeles Times, December 16, 1994, https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1994-12-16-me-9678-story.html
evidence.quote: "We may be faced with that kind of alternative," said board President John Hassel.

evidence.source: Tracey Kaplan, "1 of 2 School Bond Measures Taken Off Ballot," Los Angeles Times, July 25, 1991, https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1991-07-25-me-527-story.html
evidence.quote: Two measures to raise money for new schools were scheduled to appear on the Nov. 5 ballot

terms.note: The 2014 Facilities Foundation booklet is a memorial written after his death, retrospective but independent of the roster (it cites neither). The PDF prints an en dash in "1991 - 1999"; quoted here with a hyphen. The election date Nov. 5, 1991 is the general district election date given by the LA Times of July 25, 1991; no source names Hassel on that ballot.

people.not_found: 1991 candidate list and returns for the Hart board.

people.name: Paula Olivares
people.result: partly found (service by June 1994 independently confirmed; the 1991 start rests on the roster alone)

terms.confidence: medium for the 1991 start (roster only, consistent with everything else); high for service in 1994 and her 1993-94 presidency

evidence.source: Leon Worden, William S. Hart Union High School District Governing Board Members, 1945 to Date, SCVHistory.com, /scvhistory/hartschoolboardmembers.htm
evidence.quote: Paula E. Olivares, Asst. Clerk (elected 1991)

evidence.source: Mark Sabbatini, "Board OKs Program Requiring Students to Wear Uniforms," Los Angeles Times, June 10, 1994, https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1994-06-10-me-2780-story.html
evidence.quote: Paula Olivares, president of Hart's board of trustees, said she voted for the uniforms

evidence.source: Mark Sabbatini, "Survey Ordered on Valedictorian Policy," Los Angeles Times, August 12, 1994, https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1994-08-12-me-26477-story.html
evidence.quote: Board President Paula Olivares said an in-depth survey ... would begin in November or December.

evidence.source: California Elections Data Archive (CEDA), CEDA1995Data.xls, rows 1422-1427, a compilation of the County's returns (inventory/elections/ceda-scv.json)
evidence.quote: Paula Olivares, 3,628, elected, incumbent, designation "Governing Board Member"

terms.note: The roster makes her President on the board of 12-8-1993 to 11-30-1994; the LA Times of June and August 1994 agrees.

disagreements: Bowman 1996 yearbook caption (OCR): "Front (I tor) Mrs. Hanrion. Mr. William Dinsenbachcr. President Ms. Paula Olivares." The roster makes Dinsenbacher president 1995-96. The OCR punctuation may have moved "President" off Dinsenbacher; not a reliable disagreement, and after 1995 in any case.

people.name: Patricia Hanrion
people.result: found (elected November 2, 1993; no appointment before it)

terms.how: elected, first of five candidates for three seats at large, 9,794 votes (22%)

evidence.source: "Final Election Returns," Los Angeles Times, November 4, 1993, https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1993-11-04-me-53120-story.html
evidence.quote: William S. Hart Union High School District 3 Elected 100% Precincts Reporting: votes (%) Patricia Hanrion: 9,794 (22%) Peter C. Warren: 9,126 (21%) W. Dinsenbacher*: 8,943 (20%) Sandra L. Loberg*: 8,506 (19%) Dennis V. King*: 7,934 (18%)

evidence.source: Douglas Alger, "Election Wrapup : Conservatives Gain Board Seats in Santa Clarita School Districts," Los Angeles Times, November 4, 1993, https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1993-11-04-me-53137-story.html
evidence.quote: Warren and fellow newcomer Patricia Hanrion toppled two incumbents

evidence.source: Jonathan Gaw, "Lists of Candidates Finalized in 5 School Board Elections," Los Angeles Times, August 12, 1993, https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1993-08-12-me-23205-story.html
evidence.quote: Three members of the William S. Hart district board are being challenged by parent Patricia Hanrion and Peter Warren

evidence.source: Leon Worden, William S. Hart Union High School District Governing Board Members, 1945 to Date, SCVHistory.com, /scvhistory/hartschoolboardmembers.htm
evidence.quote: Patricia A. Hanrion (elected 1993)

evidence.source: Douglas Alger, "Board OKs New Secondary School Boundaries in Santa Clarita," Los Angeles Times, March 11, 1994, https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1994-03-11-me-32894-story.html
evidence.quote: "The two new schools are in the wrong places, basically," Trustee Patricia Hanrion said.

evidence.source: Patricia A. "Pat" Hanrion, candidate page, Smart Voter (League of Women Voters of California), November 6, 2001 election, information supplied by the candidate, read in the Wayback Machine's copy of 15 December 2001, http://web.archive.org/web/20011215100241/http://www.smartvoter.org:80/2001/11/06/ca/la/vote/hanrion_p/
evidence.quote: Wm S. Hart Union H.S. Board Member since 1993

evidence.source: Patricia Ann "Pat" Hanrion, "Goals and Philosophy," Smart Voter, November 8, 2005 election, supplied by the candidate, read in the Wayback Machine's copy of 17 May 2008, http://web.archive.org/web/20080517143529/http://www.smartvoter.org:80/2005/11/08/ca/la/vote/hanrion_p/paper1.html
evidence.quote: Lack of continuity of core curriculum across the district was a weakness I wanted to correct when elected in 1993.

terms.note: Before 1993 she appears only as a parent and "vice president of the district's advisory council" (LA Times, July 25, 1991), not as a trustee. Smart Voter statements are the candidate's own and unchecked by the League. Archive #28616 already holds 1993-12 to 1997-12 from the roster; the dry run's "first recorded win 1997" predates it.

disagreements: 1997: the roster says both "did not seek reelection in 1997" (1996-97 board) and "reelected 1997" (1997-98 board). CEDA 1997 and the LA Times final returns of Nov 6, 1997 settle it: reelected. Vote counts differ: CEDA 5,102 (second of four; Mercado 5,379), LA Times 4,780 (28%) (second; Mercado 5,037). The Times printed election-night figures; CEDA presumably the canvass.

others_1985_1995.missing_from_archive: none. Every trustee the roster places on the board between 1985 and 1995 has a person record and a Hart holding: McKeon #26978, Keysor #28797, Stroup #28799, Heidt #28795, Loberg #28801, King #28590/#28592, Dinsenbacher #28803, Warren #28805, Hassel, Olivares, Hanrion, Aliano. Student board members are not counted.

findings.finding: Elected Nov 2, 1993, second of five, 9,126 votes (21%) (LA Times Nov 4, 1993). Resignation: roster "elected 1993, resigned 4-6-1994"; LA Times May 17, 1994: "Peter Warren vacated in March" and "Warren, 36, resigned in March, 105 days after he was elected". 105 days from the election (Nov 2) is Feb 15, 1994; from the roster's first meeting (Dec 8, 1993) it is March 23, 1994. Disagreement: roster April 6 against the Times's March. Both should be footnoted; neither stated.

findings.finding: The roster says each "did not seek reelection in 1993". The LA Times says they ran and lost: "All three trustees for the William S. Hart Union High School District have filed: William Dinsenbacher, Dennis King and Sandra Loberg" (Aug 7, 1993); returns Loberg* 8,506 (19%) fourth, King* 7,934 (18%) fifth for three seats (Nov 4, 1993); "Warren and fellow newcomer Patricia Hanrion toppled two incumbents". The holdings say howEnded expired; by the Times it is defeated. A second roster error of the same kind as the Hanrion 1997 note.

findings.finding: Lost in 1985 (fifth of seven, 1,056 votes; LA Times Nov 7, 1985), consistent with the roster (appointed 12-7-1987). Unopposed in 1989 (LA Times Aug 12 and Oct 21, 1989). Reelected Nov 2, 1993, third, 8,943 (20%). Hart 1988 commencement program lists "Mr. Wm. S. Dinsenbacher, Member" with King President, Loberg Clerk, Stroup Ass't Clerk, Heidt Member, matching the roster's 1987-88 board.

searches.where: Reggie mirror /Volumes/Reggie/SCVHistory/scvhistory.com, all .htm/.html/.txt/.shtml/.asp/.php (33,705 files, including flipbook basic-html and _ocr pages)
searches.how: Python, bytes decoded cp1252, case-insensitive regex; 2026-10-05
searches.result: Only the roster, Bowman 1996 yearbook p.7, Hart 1988 commencement p.4, the SCV Facilities Foundation 2014 booklet (Hassel), LW column lw050805 (Hassel as a Foundation director, 2005) and unrelated name matches. No Signal page or Worden column on the 1991, 1993 or 1994 Hart elections or appointment.

searches.where: SCV Facilities Foundation PDF on the mirror
LA Times archive (latimes.com site search, which indexes la-xpm archive stories from 1985)
searches.how: curl of https://www.latimes.com/search?q=<term>&s=1 (newest) pages 1-4 and s=2 (oldest first) pages 1-25, then every 1985-1997 story fetched and its JSON-LD articleBody searched for the surname with "Hart"; 2026-10-05. Multi-word queries returned no archive results at all, so only single surnames were effective.
terms: plus multi-word queries (George Aliano, Peter Warren Hart, Hart board vacancy, Hart trustee appointed, Santa Clarita school board 1991, Wm. S. Hart, and others), which returned nothing from the archive
searches.result: 23 relevant stories saved. Not found: any 1991 Hart candidate list or returns; the Warren resignation story (a "Warren" search is too common to page through).

searches.result: No 1997 or 1999 Hart pages captured; Hanrion only in 2001 and 2005 (saved, redacted).

searches.where: inventory/elections (CEDA json, County PDFs and their text)
searches.result: CEDA begins 1995. The County PDFs are 2013 and later; historical-results-7 is the City of Santa Clarita. No pre-1995 Hart data.

searches.how: ddev craft exec, officeHoldings and other entries related to #21588; 2026-10-05
searches.result: Holdings exist for every 1985-1995 trustee (roster-based, made 3 October). No Hart election record before November 7, 1995.
Led only to the Smart Voter Hanrion pages. Wikipedia not used.

Hart district board minutes 1991-1994 (not online as far as known); The Signal 1991-1994 (not in the mirror for these events, not online); LA County Registrar-Recorder past results (lavote.gov) for 1991 and 1993 (not checked this pass; the County's online archive is not known to reach 1991); newspapers.com or ProQuest (no access).

proposals_not_made: #28602 Aliano: termStartEdtf 1994 -> 1994-05 (or 1994-05-18 with "scheduled" in the note); add the LA Times May 17, 1994 footnote beside the roster.
#28608 Hassel: add the 2014 Facilities Foundation footnote as an independent source for 1991.
#28624 Olivares: add the LA Times June 10 and August 12, 1994 footnotes (service and presidency in 1994); 1991 start stays roster-only.
#28616 Hanrion: add the LA Times returns of November 4, 1993 and the candidate statements; create an election record for November 2, 1993 (five candidates, three seats, returns above).
#28805 Warren: footnote both end dates (roster 6 April 1994; LA Times "in March").
#28801 Loberg and #28592 King: howEnded defeated, with the roster note and the LA Times returns both footnoted.
#28797 Keysor: howEnded did not run (1985 candidate list), medium.
Election records for November 5, 1985 (LA Times returns) and November 7, 1989 (uncontested) are possible from the saved pages; 1991 needs a source.
The dry run (board-holdings-dry-run-2026-10-03.txt section 4) is stale for Hanrion and the three 1995 incumbents: their earlier service is already held from the roster.
